name: powerpoint
description: Build PowerPoint decks that inherit your own template's styling, and audit them against Guy Kawasaki's 10/20/30 rule.

docs_dir.title: Presentations folder
docs_dir.description: The single folder of .pptx files the server may open and save, searched recursively. NEW decks are created here too - there is no separate output folder. REQUIRED: the server refuses to start without it. Defaults to the PowerPoint folder of the Eva working tree; copy the repo's eva\ folder to C:\Eva and it exists.

templates_dir.title: Templates folder
templates_dir.description: Folder of blank .pptx/.potx templates new decks are created from. Read-only: templates can be opened and used as a starting point, never saved over, and it must be separate from the presentations folder. Enter 'off' to run with no templates.

kb_dir.title: Knowledge-base folder
kb_dir.description: Every deck opened, created or saved is also mirrored to Markdown here (slides and speaker notes), which is what makes it searchable by the knowledge-base plugin. Keep it inside that plugin's documents folder (C:\Eva\knowledge) or the mirrors are never indexed. Enter 'off' to disable mirroring.

python.title: Python interpreter
python.description: Absolute path to the python.exe that has this server's pip dependencies installed (e.g. C:\Python311\python.exe). Use plain 'python' only if the right interpreter is first on PATH - a mismatch here is the most common cause of 'dependency missing' errors.
